The  Colorado  Potato  Bug.  Coleoptera.

"This  insect  belongs  to  the  same  family  as  the  squash  bug,  the  black  potato
bug,  and  the  Cantharides — all  possess  the  power  of  blistering  the  skin  if  bruised

the  Solanum  tuberosum,  the  common  potato,  and  rapidly  travelled  East,  until
it  reached  the  Atlantic."     Hale's  Symptomatology.
